entities.name: Build PBK Technologies portfolio Control Room
entities.summary: Project one bounded, queryable portfolio model as Overview, Board, Features, dependency-first Roadmap, and persistent History with clickable evidence and product snapshots.

acceptance: All views derive from one strict portfolio document
Roadmap visualizes dependencies without deadlines or a time axis
Working horizon and persistent accepted history remain distinct
Features expose research, design, definition of done, journeys, evidence, and snapshots
Operator priority cannot override dependency readiness
Course-platform Any/All/Exclude/Unlabeled label laws select the same identities for every presentation
Typed metadata supports bounded agent-authored queries without replacing dependency or evidence relations
Strict JSON rows assemble into one content-addressed snapshot and any database remains a derived index
Only evidence-backed acceptance receipts realize work output candidates as durable artifact values
Roadmap offers graph and semantic-zoom Mosaic renderers over exactly the same work identities

relations.summary: The PBK portfolio views extend the accepted phone-first Control Room and its content-custody boundary.
The explorer gains dependency-first portfolio navigation over one immutable model.
